concerns.text: Task T058 [US3] [FR-006] 'Edge Case Sensitivity Analysis' is marked as unimplemented (checkbox unchecked) and the analyze report flags it as rejected due to missing code. This leaves the spec's Edge Case requirement for 'flat objects' (zero depth variance) and the plan's robustness requirement unimplemented. No alternative task covers the specific epsilon sweep for flat objects.

Task T046 [US1] 'Implement Execution Integrity Check' is marked as unimplemented (checkbox unchecked) and flagged as rejected in the analyze report. This task is a hard dependency for T047 (Final Paired Dataset Assembly) and T052 (Full Pipeline Runner). Without T046, the pipeline cannot verify run integrity before aggregation, blocking the entire analysis phase.

Task T047 [US2] 'Final Paired Dataset Assembly' is marked as unimplemented (checkbox unchecked). It depends on T046. The spec requires a paired dataset for statistical comparison (FR-004, FR-007), and the plan requires this assembly for T048. The missing implementation blocks the generation of the final statistical report.

Task T060 [US2] [FR-007] 'Baseline Re-run Consistency Check' is marked as unimplemented (checkbox unchecked). The spec requires re-running the baseline on identical instances (FR-007), and the plan requires verifying baseline determinism to avoid confounding variance. The missing task leaves the paired comparison validity unverified.

Task T061 [US3] [FR-005] 'Multiple Comparison Correction Verification' is marked as unimplemented (checkbox unchecked). The spec requires Bonferroni correction (FR-005, SC-002). While T030 implements the correction, T061 is the specific verification task to ensure the correction was applied correctly. Its absence leaves the statistical validity of the p-values unverified.

Task T049 [P] 'Reproducibility Archive' and T056 [US3] 'Budget Compliance Report' are marked as unimplemented. While T049 is a 'Polish' task, T056 is critical for verifying the plan's constraint (SC-004: ≤6 hours runtime). The missing T056 means the project cannot formally verify it met the GitHub Actions free-tier budget constraint.

Task T050 [US1] 'Implement Kernel Blockage Final Audit' is marked as unimplemented. The spec requires verifying that no 3D libraries are used (Independent Test for US-1). While T019 and T042 exist, T050 is the specific final audit task to ensure the entire run is clean. Its absence leaves the core constraint (FR-001) unverified at the final stage.
